## Purpose

Reads `GET /api/v1/health/live` for the status card of the admin home page.

## Techniques

A feature module: an API factory registered through `Features.registry.ts` (`apiServices`), provided to pages by a React context; TanStack Query hooks for server data. It imports no other feature.

## Technologies

Axios, TanStack Query.

## Entry points

`createHealthApi`, `HEALTH_QUERY_KEYS`, `HealthApiProvider` / `useHealthApi`.

## Where to change what

Another health check: `Health.api.ts` and its query key; the card is in `views/status`.
